outcome.technical: plugins/audit/hooks/_config.py: (1) git_place asks git a second time, for the fields alone, only when the refused combined question is a top git cannot give (_top_refused: a git directory stands at or above the directory before any .git entry - _git_dir_above, a locale-free disk fact - or git's refusal carries 'must be run in a work tree', _REFUSED_TOP) AND time is left of the caller's timeout; the retry gets only what is left (time.monotonic around the first ask). A timeout or an unrunnable git is asked once. Chosen over asking --is-bare-repository because that is a second process on exactly the paths (timeout, exception) the acceptance says must not ask twice. (2) One predicate, _holds_repository (a .git entry or the HEAD/objects/refs git-dir shape, _git_dir_shaped), is now read by both witnesses: _no_repository_above (refusals) and _inside_known_tree (answers, and _tree_of_dir's containment), so a bare repository made between a directory and its top drops the kept answer. _dot_git_identity for a .git directory now carries (st_ino, st_size, st_mtime_ns) of .git/config (one lstat), so core.bare/core.worktree changes drop the answer. Cost was judged acceptable, so the config identity is implemented, not merely documented; the block comment above _STANDING_FIELDS states the two limits that remain (a .git FILE's config in the common dir is not read; the shape test does not validate HEAD) and the retry rule, including that a translated git in a checkout configured bare is answered None. _DISCOVERY_ENV untouched. (3) standing_approval reads arm/revoke rows through _journal_io.last_words (loaded via journal_lib(), the hooks' existing path loader - hooks still import nothing from scripts/ at module scope); a revoking among the newest second's last words reads as not armed with revokedAt kept; arming rows alone keep the one read last; raises RuntimeError when the journal reader cannot be loaded (every caller already catches and reports 'could not be read'). tests/test__config.py: new st8, st9 (_git_place_ask_cases, stubbed _ask_rev_parse), st10, st11 (_git_witness_cases, real git fixtures, each first showing git's fresh answer moved), sp1 (_standing_tie_cases). Suite 386/386. Gate: sweep of the four files exit 0 (4/4 files ok, 725 cases); bench-hooks --gate exit 0 (10 hooks within budget on 3.14.7; 3.8-3.13 NOT MEASURED, no interpreter here). ruff exit 0, vermin exit 0 (min 3.7), house_style_violations/prose_number_claims over the tree: 0 hits. Mutation probe (delivered at <scratchpad>/P155.2-probe/mutations.py, run with a tree as cwd; the plan gate refused writing probe/mutations.py inside the task tree as undeclared) run in a throwaway copy of the tree, never the task tree: 9 of 9 mutations killed, exit 0 - retry gate dropped -> st8; budget check dropped -> st8; whole timeout passed to the retry -> st9; shape gate dropped -> st9; text gate dropped -> st9+st11; answer witness back to .git-only -> st10; config identity dropped -> st11; tie read as last row -> sp1; over-fire (any revoke ever) -> sp1. Dependants: _locks.lock_dir and _worktrees (git_place callers) still correct - test__locks 148 and test__worktrees 156 cases green; _journal_io.git_place caller and _scoped_commit/audit-task callers green (test__journal_io 276, test__scoped_commit 81, test_audit_task 1200); _tree_of_dir/guard-bash-writes now hand a git-dir-shaped intermediate directory back to git, the conservative direction - test_guard_bash_writes 239 green; standing_approval readers drive-phase.standing_use, _doctor_trail.check_standing_approval, audit-status.standing_approval_block all wrap the call in try/except, so the new RuntimeError reads as 'could not be read' - test__doctor_trail 155, test_audit_doctor 173, test_audit_status 408, test_detect_plan_skip 46, test_drive_phase --stage uv-block 15/15 (sh1a-sh1d) green; every hook imports _config - bench-hooks gate green. The other declared files (PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md, tests/test__affected_tests.py, tests/test__doctor_trail.py, tests/test_drive_phase.py, tools/lints/_deps.py, tools/prove-gates.py, tests/_harness.py, tests/test__deps.py, tools/sweep-selftests.py, stamp-verification.py, tests/test__runner_collects.py, tests/test_stamp_verification.py) were not edited: none names the changed functions' behaviour (grep of PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md not needed - no new module, no new public name).
outcome.descriptive: The git place memo no longer asks git twice after a timeout or an unrunnable git, both of its witnesses read one 'a repository stands here' predicate plus the top's .git/config identity, and a same-second arm and revoke from two sessions reads as not armed.

verifiedBy: st8: a stubbed _ask_rev_parse that times out (in a checkout and in a bare repository) or reports git unrunnable is called once by git_place, its reason handed back; st9: the fields-alone retry still runs where a git directory stands (refusal in another language) or the refusal names a work tree, with no more than what is left of the timeout; st10: a bare repository made between a directory and its top drops the kept answer; st11: core.bare set in top/.git/config drops it; sp1: an arm and a revoke in one second from two sessions read as not armed whichever file sorts first, while a later second or one session's own order still decides
